label: Core
description: Code-backed platform primitives: triggers, agents, generic tools, control flow, outputs. Executed by apps/reasoner/reasoner/nodes.py, not the generic integration runtime.

nodes.label: Manual trigger
nodes.description: Start the workflow on demand; seeds the run input downstream.
nodes.search: start manual run on demand trigger begin

nodes.label: Webhook trigger
nodes.description: Start the workflow from an incoming HTTP request.
nodes.search: webhook http trigger incoming event start

nodes.label: Schedule trigger
nodes.description: Run on a cron schedule (e.g. every weekday at 9am).
nodes.search: schedule cron daily hourly recurring timer trigger

nodes.label: AI agent
nodes.description: Reason over upstream outputs with a large language model. The workhorse for research, synthesis, extraction, transformation and summarization.
nodes.search: ai llm agent reason summarize synthesize extract classify write analyze transform parse

config.label: Model
config.help: Leave unset to use the deployment default (REASONER_MODEL). Set only when the user names a specific model.

nodes.label: Chat completion
nodes.description: Single-turn prompt → response, no tool use.
nodes.search: chat completion single turn prompt response llm

config.label: Model
config.help: Leave unset to use the deployment default (REASONER_MODEL). Set only when the user names a specific model.

nodes.label: Browser
nodes.description: Drive a real browser: navigate URLs and extract page text. For JS-heavy or auth-walled sites a plain HTTP request can't read.
nodes.search: browser navigate scrape extract page web visit javascript render click

nodes.label: HTTP request
nodes.description: Call any REST API or fetch any URL. The universal escape hatch for data sources without a dedicated node.
nodes.search: http api rest get post fetch request call url json rss feed

nodes.label: Run code
nodes.description: Execute a Python or JavaScript snippet in a sandboxed subprocess. Upstream outputs and run input arrive as JSON on stdin. Requires TOOL_CODE_ENABLED=1; otherwise the code is recorded, not executed.
nodes.search: code python javascript execute script transform parse compute csv json convert

config.label: Source
config.help: stdin = {"input": …, "outputs": …}; print a JSON object to emit fields

nodes.label: Database query
nodes.description: Run SQL against the operator-configured TOOL_DB_URL database. Without TOOL_DB_URL the query is recorded, not executed. Never touches the platform database.
nodes.search: database sql query select insert postgres rows

credentials.help: Postgres URL of the user-facing database this node may query

nodes.label: If / Else
nodes.description: Gate: evaluate a condition; when false, the entire downstream subgraph is skipped.
nodes.search: if else branch condition gate compare decide

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Gate: pass the flow through only when the condition holds; otherwise skip downstream.
nodes.search: filter condition keep when rule gate

nodes.label: Loop
nodes.description: Fan out: resolve a list and run the downstream branch once per item. Inside the body, {{item}} is the current element and {{loop.<key>.index}} the position; collected results appear as outputs.<key>.results.
nodes.search: loop foreach iterate items map fan out each repeat

nodes.label: Send email
nodes.description: Deliver an email over the platform SMTP seam; records intent when SMTP is unconfigured.
nodes.search: email send mail deliver notify digest smtp

config.label: Body
config.help: Defaults to the most recent upstream text output

nodes.label: Send to Slack
nodes.description: Post a message to a Slack incoming webhook; records intent when unconfigured.
nodes.search: slack post webhook message notify output

nodes.label: Generate report
nodes.description: Compose a markdown or PDF report artifact from upstream text.
nodes.search: report artifact markdown pdf compose document digest
